narrative_purpose: Puts three unrelated lineages side by side to show one convergent solution: a thin bare vascularised surface held away from the body core, whose only job is dumping heat.
subject: Three separate anatomical studies arranged in a horizontal row against dark ground, each isolated with clear space around it. Left: the broad flat bony head-fan of a heavy six-limbed grazing animal, seen from slightly behind so fine branching vessels are visible tracing across its thin membrane. Centre: the head and neck of a tall blue-skinned humanoid seen from behind and slightly above, its two large pointed mobile ears spread wide, fine vessels visible along their thin edges. Right: one stretched translucent wing membrane of a large flying creature, backlit so its whole vascular network shows through the membrane as a fine branching tracery.
scene: A dark naturalist's specimen wall, the three studies floating as if pinned separately for comparison, deep atmospheric haze behind them.
camera: Flat-on comparison view, all three studies at similar apparent scale, evenly spaced across the frame.
light: Warm interior glow bleeding through each thin membrane from behind, making the vessel tracery visible; cool ambient fill from the front; deep indigo shadow between the three studies.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cool teal on the outer surfaces, a scarce warm ember glow shining through the thin membranes from within to signal heat.
style: Painterly naturalist comparative-anatomy plate, hand-painted texture, three studies in one consistent hand.
detail_level: Crisp on the vessel branching in all three membranes; the bodies they attach to only suggested; edges dissolving into haze.
composition: Three evenly spaced studies in a row, each with dark plain space around and above it, generous quiet margins.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with a scarce warm glow used only to read as internal heat. All three membranes must be bare, thin and visibly vascular; no insulating fur or down anywhere. Keep the space above each study dark and plain for overlaid callouts.
negative_prompt: no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no diagram lines, no fur, no feathers, no flat vector art, no infographic styling, no UI, no watermarks, no 3D render
